title: Fix missing marketing logo in header/footer

requirements.text: Fix the marketing site logo so it renders reliably in the deployed build, including the header and footer.
acceptanceCriteria: When loading the deployed app, the logo image is visible in the header area (left side) without requiring a refresh.
The footer logo image is visible and matches the header logo.
The browser DevTools Network tab shows no 404/failed request for the logo image asset(s) under /assets/generated/ on initial page load.

requirements.text: Make the header and footer use a single shared logo source of truth (the same exported logo path and alt text), and ensure the referenced logo asset path corresponds to an actual file shipped in the frontend static assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Header.tsx does not hardcode a different logo path than the shared exported logo constant used elsewhere.
Both header and footer reference the same LOGO_SRC/LOGO_ALT values.
If the logo file is missing or fails to load, a graceful fallback remains visible (e.g., the brand name text still displays and layout does not collapse).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Backend is a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services or external storage for static assets.
nonGoals: Implementing new authentication or backend functionality.
Changing marketing copy or adding new site sections unrelated to the logo rendering issue.
